summary: Maya-user tour of the Level Editor layout (menu bar, toolbars, viewport, Outliner, Details, Content Drawer), viewport navigation and transform hotkeys, and a table mapping editor modes (Landscape, Foliage, Mesh Paint, Modeling, Fracture) to Maya equivalents.
Parrot sample page explaining that each level has its own Level Blueprint event graph (used in Parrot to drive level sequences) and how to open it via the World Blueprint button.
gotchas: Logic in a Level Blueprint is not portable or reusable in other levels

summary: Parrot sample page showing a Level Sequence that moves a shark obstacle along a spline with a path track and switches its animations through an event track.

Unity-to-Unreal map of major systems (Chaos physics, traces, AI perception/Behavior Trees/StateTree/navigation/Smart Objects, Animation Blueprints, Sequencer, Enhanced Input, Landscape/Foliage/PCG/Water, Lumen, post-process options, materials and instances, Nanite, MetaSounds, Niagara, UMG, SaveGame) with links and a feature-name comparison table.
gotchas: Written against UE 5.5.4 and Unity 6; features may differ in other versions

summary: How to sync a GitHub fork of the Unreal Engine source with Epic's repository, either via an upstream git remote (recommended) or a GitHub Sync Fork pull request.
gotchas: Only relevant when building the engine from source
GitHub PR method adds extra commits/PRs to history

summary: Parrot sample's UI architecture: enabling CommonUI with CommonGameViewportClient and Enhanced Input support, a HUD-owned root layout with Game/GameMenu/Menu/Modal activatable widget layers, button styling via UCommonButtonStyle, and async level loading with the CommonLoadingScreen plugin instead of Open Level.
gotchas: Only one widget per layer is active at a time
Open Level loads synchronously and can hitch; viewport widgets tied to the old player controller are destroyed on transition
CommonUI is required for Enhanced Input key remapping
Editor restart needed after enabling CommonUI

summary: Maya-user overview of Sequencer: Level Sequence assets/actors, shots, tracks, curve editor, Control Rig constraints, Animator Kit deformers, Transform track use, Media Viewer plugin, and rendering via Movie Render Queue/Graph and Quick Render.
gotchas: Putting a Transform track on a rig's top node causes double transforms; apply it to the actor instead

summary: Maya-user intro to UE materials: Material Domain, Blend Mode and Shading Model, Hypershade-to-UE input mapping (Base Color, Metallic, Roughness, etc.), common graph nodes, material vs material instance trade-offs, texture tips (channel packing, power-of-two), Substrate and PBR.
gotchas: Non-power-of-two textures don't use Texture Streaming and can show artifacts at distance
Editing a base material requires recompiling; instance parameter changes do not

summary: Unity-dev primer on C++/Blueprint setup (Visual Studio, refreshing project files) and the AActor/UActorComponent equivalents of MonoBehaviour Start/Update/OnDestroy; code samples are missing from the extract.
gotchas: Must explicitly call parent methods (Super::) in overrides
Visual Studio project files sometimes need manual regeneration
Open Visual Studio menu item only appears once the project has a C++ class

summary: Hub for automotive HMI teams: team roles and platforms, plus links to onboarding, profiling (Insights, RenderDoc, stat commands), mobile shading, UMG, macOS/Xcode, Linux and Android debugging pages.
Hub page for mobile packaging: links to Packaging iOS Projects and Packaging and Publishing for Android.
C++ reference for creating UObject instances with NewObject, NewNamedObject and ConstructObject, including parameters (Outer, Class, Name, Flags, Template) and the EObjectFlags table.
gotchas: RF_RootSet objects are never garbage collected

summary: Explains MODULE_API macros (e.g. ENGINE_API) that export classes/functions from a module DLL so other modules can call them, and how they map to dllexport/dllimport or nothing in monolithic builds.
gotchas: Only matter in modular (DLL) builds; empty in monolithic builds
Needed only for statically imported modules
